title: physostegia correllii
intro: Physostegia correllii, commonly known as Coralroot, is a perennial plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Coralroot are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activities, potentially addressing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Physostegia correllii include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
